chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 339: Ji Ning vs. Blade Servant – A Battle of Sword and Blade
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning faces his toughest test yet in the Immortal Fortunes Assembly. The savage speed of the Blade Servant clashes with the overwhelming power of a Sword Immortal.
og_title: The Top Twenty-Four Begin: Ji Ning Cuts Down the Blade Fiend
og_description: The Immortal Fortunes Assembly reaches its climax as the top twenty-four battle for a place in the top twelve. The clash between the sword and the blade reaches a bloody conclusion.
twitter_title: Blood and Blades: Ji Ning Wins the First Match!
twitter_description: Ji Ning goes toe-to-toe with the terrifying Blade Servant, pushing him to the limit in a savage, high-speed duel.

lore_anchors.definition: The Grand Xia Dynasty's grand tournament to recruit the most talented Wanxiang Adepts into the imperial army.
A divine ability allowing Fiendgod Body Refiners to grow to colossal size, multiplying their strength and durability.
A combat divine ability that allows a cultivator to manifest extra limbs for a massive increase in offensive and defensive capacity.
A top-ten divine ability since Pangu, allowing the user's hands to shatter magic treasures.
The creator of the Crimsonbright Diagram of the Nine Heavens, the number one Fiendgod Body Refining technique in the Three Realms.
The ultimate essence of natural energy, used as high-value currency for large purchases among cultivators.
The fourth major realm of Ki Refining in which a cultivator's Violet Palace develops stars and the moon.
The ruler of the Grand Xia Dynasty, a figure of immense power who personally oversees the Immortal Fortunes Assembly.
